artifacts.bundle_name: Alex Jones interview clip with Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: Alex Jones segment in which Phil Lyman recounts being at the east end outside, hearing a loud boom, encountering two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee and one of whom said "Go f yourselves," and his stated view that the .30-06 rifle was never fired from the roof.

artifacts.bundle_name: NewsNation interview clip with Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: NewsNation segment in which Phil Lyman describes walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him and then running back out to investigate.

artifacts.bundle_name: Post-shooting video footage sent to host by Phil Lyman

sub_items.description: Mobile phone video with embedded metadata timestamp 12:23 showing Phil Lyman inside the Sorensen Center building walking out calmly and engaging two people in black clothing in conversation; no one in the clip is depicted fleeing.

BearingPoint Graz office introduction video identifying members of one of the company's software development teams; the host identifies one of the individuals shown as Gernot Ohner and displays a side-by-side with the figure in the Broderick companion photo.

Blog post titled "Anniversary Hike, 10 Years on Foot to the Sea," describing a group of 30-year-olds recreating a hike taken at age 20; contains photos matching the face of the individual identified as Gernot Ohner.

artifacts.bundle_name: Buzzards and Bees website (Provo gothic underground)

sub_items.description: Public-facing page from the "Buzzards and Bees" gothic-underground Provo website referencing a "gothic prom," featuring a person in makeup the host matches via side-by-side image to the unidentified individual in the Broderick companion photo.

artifacts.bundle_name: Daily Mail article on FBI Utah leadership purge

sub_items.description: Article headlined "Kash Patel questions grow as it's revealed he gutted the Utah FBI leadership before Charlie Kirk's assassination," recounting that Patel fired the Utah Bureau chief and other personnel and installed Robert Bohls in August 2025.

artifacts.bundle_name: November 1999 article on Detective Mike Mitchell

sub_items.description: Article titled "Police surf internet to snag pedophiles," describing Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Detective Mike Mitchell using an online persona with childlike language to lure suspected pedophiles; states Mitchell had been investigating internet child-sex crimes for about a year (i.e., since approximately 1998) and was assigned to the Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office.

Letter attributed to Charlie Kirk expressing "deep love for Israel," reported to have been written in May and released by the Prime Minister's office roughly two weeks after the September 10 assassination; circulated via the New York Post and Israeli Post. Referenced on air; underlying letter/email not displayed.
Instagram post by Shaner Broderick identifying Phil Lyman as "my uncle Phil Lyman" (described on air; post itself not displayed in this episode).
Shaner Broderick LinkedIn profile connection listing Phil Lyman as uncle, referenced as a factor in his securing an internship with Senator Mike Lee of Utah.
LinkedIn profile stating Gernot Ohner relocated to Utah in May 2024 to take a software engineer position with JP Morgan Chase.

Email from a viewer in Belfast, Northern Ireland, reporting a facial-recognition search of the unidentified companion produced a single hit in Provo, Utah, on the "Buzzards and Bees" gothic-prom page.

Email from a long-time bulletproof-vest supplier stating that his contract with Charlie Kirk's campus tour was not renewed prior to the final spring tour, with the supplier told Charlie wanted to "go a different direction" using an army-style metal vest instead. Paraphrased on air; underlying email not displayed.

artifacts.bundle_name: Decentralized Intelligence Agency Tip Line Bundle

sub_items.description: Host verbal reference to the tip email address tips@candaceowens.com (verbal call for tips on the goth person)
Host verbal reference to the tip email address tips@candaceowens.com (closing call for tips)

artifacts.bundle_name: Phil Lyman Text Exchange with Host Bundle

sub_items.description: Host verbal reference to her text messages with Phil Lyman about Nick, the white vehicle, his relation to Shaner Broderick and the two unidentified companions (messages not shown)
Host reads viewer comments (Rose, Anomaly AJ, Murphy, Ashlyn Bigelow, Natalie, Marzi, George) aloud; the Marzi super chat concerns keyholing versus pinball bullets

artifacts.bundle_name: Host Conversation with Camera Individual Bundle

sub_items.description: Host verbal account of her conversation with the man who took down the cameras (conversation not shown; individual not named in this episode)

nodes.name: Shaner Broderick
nodes.description: Phil Lyman's nephew (per Broderick's own Instagram and LinkedIn) or cousin (per Phil's revised claim to the host); retraced the killer's footpath with two companions shortly after the shooting and produced a map used by media. Wiped his LinkedIn and Facebook and cleared/privatized his Instagram following the host's previous episode.

nodes.name: Gernot Ohner
nodes.description: Austrian national; identified by the host as one of two companions in the Broderick companion photo. Matched to a BearingPoint Graz software team YouTube video and a German-language "Anniversary Hike" blog; LinkedIn indicates relocation to Utah in May 2024 for a software engineering role at JP Morgan Chase.

nodes.name: Benjamin Netanyahu
nodes.description: Israeli Prime Minister; referenced as having released the May Charlie Kirk letter roughly two weeks after the September 10 assassination. (Note: transcript renders the familiar "Bibi" as "BB"; preserved as transcribed; flagged.)

nodes.name: Robert Bohls
nodes.description: Reported as the individual installed to lead the Utah FBI field office in August 2025 following Kash Patel's purge of prior leadership; described as based in DC for decades and in his first week on the job at the time of the shooting.

nodes.name: Mike Mitchell
nodes.description: Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office detective; per a 1999 article, conducts online undercover work creating personas to identify suspected pedophiles. Flag: this entity is likely to already possess a node ID from prior episodes covering his role in the Charlie Kirk case; verify ledger and merge if confirmed.

nodes.name: Kash Patel
nodes.description: FBI Director; per a Daily Mail article cited in the episode, fired the chief of the Utah FBI Bureau and other personnel and replaced them with Robert Bohls in August 2025, weeks before the assassination. Flag: may already have a node ID from prior episodes; verify ledger and merge if confirmed.

nodes.name: Phil Lyman Location Discrepancy
nodes.description: Persistent inconsistency across three artifact-anchored sources regarding Phil Lyman's position at the moment of the shot: (1) Alex Jones interview places him at the east end outdoors, (2) NewsNation interview places him entering a building and then running out, and (3) video with 12:23 metadata timestamp shows him already inside the Sorensen Center building walking out calmly.

nodes.name: Unidentified Goth Person in Broderick Companion Photo
nodes.description: The second of two foreign companions in the photo with Shaner Broderick; matched by a Belfast viewer to a person on the Provo gothic-underground site "Buzzards and Bees." Remains unidentified by name as of this episode.

nodes.name: Charlie Kirk Pre-Mortem Israel Position Claim
nodes.description: Host assertion that approximately 48 hours before his death Charlie Kirk informed Turning Point USA staff, Jewish donors, and a rabbi that he was abandoning the pro-Israel cause, and that he intended to bring Candace Owens back. Currently host-testimony only with no displayed artifact in this episode; TPUSA has been publicly challenged to deny. Verification target.

nodes.name: Hospital Routing Discrepancy
nodes.description: Host assertion that Timpanogos Regional Hospital was not the closest trauma-equipped facility and that the hospital had just named Andrew Zenger as a new CEO/surgeon on the same day Charlie's tour was announced. Lacks displayed artifact in this episode; verification target.

nodes.name: Utah FBI Personnel Replacement
nodes.description: Verified via Daily Mail: Kash Patel fired the Utah FBI Bureau chief and additional personnel, replaced by Robert Bohls in August 2025; Bowles in his first week on the job at the time of the shooting. Investigation target remains: who approved the timing, who vetted Bowles, and what the chain of command was on September 10.

claims.label: Phil Lyman told Alex Jones he was outside at the east end, heard a loud boom, encountered two girls "very goth, very black" who did not flee, and quoted one as saying "Go f yourselves."
claims.claim: In a clip the host plays of his Alex Jones appearance, Phil Lyman says he was outside at the east end when he heard a loud boom and encountered two girls, "very goth, very black," who did not flee, one of whom he quotes as saying "Go f yourselves"; the host says this is consistent with him painting a picture that he was outside when the shot rang out.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Phil's Alex Jones account verbatim against (a) the NewsNation account (C-1099) and (b) the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to characterize the discrepancy as edit, memory, or misrepresentation.

claims.label: Phil Lyman told NewsNation he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate.
claims.claim: In a NewsNation clip the host plays, Phil Lyman says he was walking into a building when he heard a loud bang behind him, then ran out to investigate; the host says this places him approaching or inside a building at the moment of the shot, then exiting.
claims.investigative_direction: Cross-reference timestamp of "ran out" with the 12:23 video metadata (A-1185.1) to determine whether Phil was inside or approaching at the moment of the shot.

claims.label: Video metadata timestamp shows Phil Lyman inside the Sorensen Center at 12:23 on the day of the shooting, walking out calmly.
claims.claim: The host says that, according to the metadata of the footage Phil Lyman sent her, he was inside the Sorensen building at 12:23 and then calmly walked out rather than running.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain original file with full EXIF metadata; forensically confirm capture time, device, and chain of custody.

claims.label: The two individuals in Phil Lyman's aftermath footage are wearing black clothing but do not display abnormal behavior; the host states one may be a man.
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman's aftermath video shows two individuals simply wearing black (one of whom she thinks is a guy) in what seems a normal conversation; she disputes Phil's Alex Jones characterization of them as "goth" and unfazed.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare visible individuals in A-1185.1 with the two companions in the Broderick photo (A-1192.1); determine whether they are the same individuals.

claims.label: Host Says One of Two Companions in Photo With Shaner Broderick Is Gernot Ohner, via Face-Match to BearingPoint Graz Video
claims.claim: The host says her team identified one of the two companions in the photo with Shaner Broderick as Gernot Ohner, whose face she says also matches an individual shown in a BearingPoint company YouTube video introducing software development teams at the Graz office.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original Broderick companion photo from prior episode; perform controlled side-by-side facial comparison and reach out to BearingPoint HR to confirm Gernot Ohner's employment dates.

claims.label: Host Says Gernot Ohner's LinkedIn States He Moved to Utah in May 2024 for a JP Morgan Chase Software Engineer Job
claims.claim: The host says that, according to Gernot Ohner's LinkedIn profile, he moved to Utah in May 2024 to take a software engineer position with JP Morgan Chase.
claims.investigative_direction: Capture and archive the LinkedIn profile as displayed; verify with JP Morgan Chase HR whether the employment record matches.

claims.label: A Belfast viewer matched the second companion's face via a facial-recognition search to a single result in Provo, Utah – on the "Buzzards and Bees" gothic-prom page.
claims.claim: A viewer in Belfast, Northern Ireland, emailed the host that an internet-wide search of the unidentified companion's face returned a single hit in Provo, Utah, on a website pertaining to bees; the host says that site, Buzzards and Bees, is a Gothic underground in Provo discussing a Gothic prom.
claims.investigative_direction: Replicate the facial search; identify the named subject on the Buzzards and Bees page; determine whether the person is Austrian or otherwise foreign.

claims.label: Shaner Broderick previously identified Phil Lyman as his uncle on both Instagram and LinkedIn.
claims.claim: The host says Shaner Broderick posted on his Instagram 'My uncle Phil Lyman' and that his LinkedIn listed Phil Lyman as an uncle connection, before Lyman said they are only cousins.
claims.investigative_direction: Archive Instagram and LinkedIn snapshots from prior to deletion/scrub; reconcile with Phil Lyman's later "cousin, not nephew" revision.

claims.label: The Daily Mail reports Kash Patel fired the Utah FBI Bureau chief and additional personnel before Charlie Kirk's assassination and replaced the chief with Robert Bohls.
claims.claim: A Daily Mail article reports FBI Director Kash Patel removed the chief of the Utah FBI Bureau and additional personnel and installed Robert Bohls in August 2025.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying DOJ/FBI HR records for the Utah field office; verify the date of Robert Bohls's transfer and the names of all removed personnel.

claims.label: A November 1999 article describes Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Detective Mike Mitchell as an undercover detective using online personas to lure suspected pedophiles, beginning approximately one year prior (i.e., circa 1998).
claims.claim: Per a November 1999 article the host shows, a Mike Mitchell, a detective with the Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office, had been investigating child sex crimes on the internet for about a year, using childlike online phrasing; the host says she is not certain it is the same Mike Mitchell but has a strong hunch.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm continuity between the 1999 Salt Lake County Sheriff's Office Mitchell and the Mike Mitchell referenced in the Charlie Kirk investigation; obtain his full service record.

claims.label: Roughly two weeks after the September 10, 2025 assassination, Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu's office released a May 2025 letter attributed to Charlie Kirk expressing "deep love for Israel" and offering strategic counsel.
claims.claim: The host says the New York Post and Israeli Post shared a May letter to Netanyahu in which Charlie Kirk reportedly 'wrote of his deep love for Israel'; she questions whether it is authentic and asks for the email to be authenticated.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the original letter or email (timestamp, metadata); reconcile with contemporaneous statements by TPUSA staff and the host's 48-hour claim.

claims.label: The supplier who had provided Charlie Kirk's campus-tour bulletproof vests reports his contract was not renewed for the final spring tour, with Charlie allegedly wanting an army-style metal vest instead.
claims.claim: An email from a long-time bulletproof-vest supplier describes contract non-renewal and a stated rationale that Charlie wanted an "army vest" direction.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the underlying email and supplier invoices; verify whether any alternative armor was actually worn on September 10 and which vendor supplied it.

claims.label: Gernot Ohner's face was matched to a German-language blog post titled "Anniversary Hike, 10 Years on Foot to the Sea" featuring a group of 30-year-olds recreating a hike taken at age 20.
claims.claim: The host says her team found that the face of the individual identified as Gernot Ohner matched photos in a German-language blog post on a 10-year hiking anniversary.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm authorship and dating of the blog; verify Gernot Ohner's participation in the original 20-year-old hike and the 10-year reunion.

claims.label: Host Thinks Robert Bohls Was in First Week at Utah FBI Office When Kirk Was Shot
claims.claim: The host says she thinks Robert Bohls was in his first week at the Utah FBI office when Charlie Kirk was shot.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Bowles's official start date via FBI HR records and tie to the timeline of investigative actions on September 10.

claims.label: Host calls Robert Bohls's move from decades in Washington to the Utah FBI post an unusual placement
claims.claim: The host says Robert Bohls, installed at the Utah FBI office in August 2025, had been in Washington DC for decades, and calls his relocation to Utah an unusual placement that adds to everything feeling "a little too brand new."
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm Robert Bohls's prior postings and the date of his Utah assignment from FBI announcements.
claims.transcript_snippet: he's somebody who has been in DC for decades. So, seems to me to be an unusual placement to then want to re-up your entire life

claims.label: Host Says Kirk Is Being Memorialized as a Friend of Israel by People Who Threatened Him
claims.claim: The host says that the very people who had been threatening Charlie Kirk reputationally and financially are now trying to memorialize him as having died as a friend of Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the specific people and statements the host means and compare their pre-September 10 conduct toward Kirk with their post-assassination tributes.
claims.transcript_snippet: the very people who were threatening him reputationally and financially are now trying to memorialize him as having died as a friend of Israel.

claims.label: Host Says Two Friends of Phil Lyman's Nephew Retraced the Killer's Path
claims.claim: The host says that on the previous day she asked the public to identify two individuals whom Phil Lyman's nephew described as close friends who retraced the path of Charlie's killer.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Shaner Broderick's original posts describing the two companions and the retrace video, and archive them before further deletion.
claims.transcript_snippet: yesterday we asked for the public's help in identifying two individuals who Phil Lyman's nephew described as his close friends who decided to retrace the path of Charlie's killer.

claims.label: Host Says Netanyahu Released the Kirk Letter About Two Weeks After the Death, Perhaps With TPUSA Help
claims.claim: The host says it took a little over two weeks, but Netanyahu, perhaps with help from Turning Point USA, is now releasing the May letter from Charlie Kirk to Israel.
claims.investigative_direction: Establish who supplied the letter to the Prime Minister's office and to the press, and whether anyone at Turning Point USA coordinated its release.
claims.transcript_snippet: It took him a little over 2 weeks but now BB Netanyahu, with maybe a little help from Turning Point USA I'm thinking, is releasing the letter

claims.label: Host Says Phil Lyman Told Fox News His Car Was in the Driveway 20 Minutes Before the Killer Passed
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman reiterated to Fox News that he parked his car in his aunt's driveway 20 minutes before the killer came limping by.
claims.investigative_direction: Locate the Fox News interview and compare Lyman's stated arrival time with the doorbell-camera footage of his vehicle.
claims.transcript_snippet: 20 minutes before I pulled into the driveway, my aunt's house and I parked my car and then 20 minutes later the killer killer was limping by.

claims.label: Host Says Shaner Broderick's Map of the Killer's Path Was Used by the Media
claims.claim: The host says Shaner Broderick created a map of where the killer walked and that the media used his map.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify which outlets published Broderick's map and how he determined the route.
claims.transcript_snippet: Shaner even created a map where exactly the killer walked and the media used his map.

claims.label: Host Says Phil Lyman Told Her Nick Never Worked on His Campaign
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman messaged her after the previous episode to say that Nick never worked on his campaign, and that the host concluded the earlier statement was her own mistake and not Nick's.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text exchange between the host and Lyman, and ask Nick how he described his relationship to the campaign.
claims.transcript_snippet: Phil would like me to clarify that Nick never worked on his campaign and by the way, I looked back and that was actually my mistake, not Nick's.

claims.label: Host Says Lyman Gave Helping Nick Identify a White Vehicle as His Reason for Visiting Nick's House
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman explained his Saturday stop at Nick's house by saying he had been helping Nick determine who owned a white vehicle parked near the shooter's route, and she says that vehicle was long gone more than two weeks later.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Nick and Lyman what, if anything, Lyman learned about the white vehicle and why that was a reason to visit on that Saturday.
claims.transcript_snippet: Nick was particularly asking him to determine who owned a white vehicle that was parked in the neighborhood which was nearby where the shooter had walked.

claims.label: Host Says a Strong Source Reports Lyman Met Tim Ballard in Town That Saturday
claims.claim: The host says that, according to a very strong source, Phil Lyman was in town on Saturday to meet with Tim Ballard.
claims.investigative_direction: Ask Ballard and Lyman whether they met that Saturday and for what purpose; compare with any public schedule.
claims.transcript_snippet: I am told according to a very strong source that what Phil Lyman was doing in town on Saturday was he was meeting with Tim Ballard.

claims.label: Host Says the Owners of the Transponder Plane Wore Operation Underground Railroad T-Shirts
claims.claim: The host says she remembers that the individuals who owned the plane with the transponder that turned off were wearing an Operation Underground Railroad t-shirt.
claims.investigative_direction: Identify the plane's owners from FAA records and find the image or report of the t-shirt that the host recalls.
claims.transcript_snippet: the individuals that owned that plane were wearing an Operation Underground Railroad t-shirt.

claims.label: Host Says Phil Lyman Now Says Shaner Is His Cousin and May Be Confused
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman disputes that Shaner Broderick is his nephew, telling her that Shaner may be confused and that they are only cousins.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain Lyman family records or public genealogy showing the relationship; compare with Broderick's earlier posts.
claims.transcript_snippet: Actually maybe Shaner's confused.

claims.label: Host Says Broderick Was Chosen for an Internship With Senator Mike Lee
claims.claim: The host says Shaner Broderick was chosen for an internship with Senator Mike Lee of Utah, which she thinks was partly the result of the family link to Phil Lyman.
claims.investigative_direction: Confirm the internship dates with Senator Lee's office and whether the Lyman relationship was listed in the application.
claims.transcript_snippet: chosen for an internship with Senator Mike Lee of Utah.

claims.label: Host Says Broderick Wiped His LinkedIn and Facebook and Privatized Instagram After Her Previous Episode
claims.claim: The host says that since the previous episode Shaner Broderick wiped his LinkedIn page and his Facebook page, and privatized his Instagram and then removed the photos of his investigation into who Charlie Kirk's killer was.
claims.investigative_direction: Retrieve archived copies of the deleted pages and note the dates of deletion relative to the host's outreach.
claims.transcript_snippet: He's also completely wiped his Facebook page entirely. And regarding his Instagram, he's privatized it but he privatized it and then removed all of the photos of his investigation

claims.label: Host Says She Asked Lyman Three Times by Text to Help Identify the Two People in the Photo
claims.claim: The host says she asked Phil Lyman three times by text whether he could help identify the two individuals in the photo with his nephew or cousin.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text thread showing each request and Lyman's replies.
claims.transcript_snippet: I asked Phil Lyman three times via text whether or not he could help us, more importantly, identify the two individuals that were in the photo with his nephew or cousin

claims.label: Host Says Lyman Finally Said He Had No Idea Who the Two Individuals Were
claims.claim: The host says Phil Lyman at first acted confused about which photo she meant, despite her sending it several times, and finally said he had no idea who the two individuals were.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the text thread with Lyman and ask Broderick who the two companions were.
claims.transcript_snippet: And then finally he said that he had no idea who those two individuals were at all.

claims.label: Host Says Nobody Emailed to Identify Either of the Two Companions
claims.claim: The host says that, unlike in all her earlier investigations, no viewer emailed to say they knew either the blonde or the person in the blue hat who were with Shaner Broderick.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the tip-line log to confirm no identification arrived and test whether the two are from outside the United States.
claims.transcript_snippet: no one emailed us to say that they knew either of those two individuals, neither the blonde that's with Shaner or the person that is wearing the blue hat

claims.label: Host Says the Man in the Blue Hat Resembles the Blurred Stairs Figure More Than Tyler Robinson Does
claims.claim: The host says the man in the blue hat resembles, more than Tyler Robinson does, the blurred image of the individual coming up the stairs, and that he looks about the same height.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare the blue-hat man's height and build with the blurred stairs frame and with Robinson using a calibrated photogrammetric comparison.
claims.transcript_snippet: He kind of resembles certainly more so than Tyler Robinson does, the blurred image of the individual that was coming up the stairs.

claims.label: Host Says One Companion Is Austrian, Which Explains Why Nobody Recognized Him
claims.claim: The host says one of the two individuals in the photo was identified as an Austrian, which she says explains why no viewer recognized him.
claims.investigative_direction: Verify Gernot Ohner's nationality and Utah residency through public records and his employer.
claims.transcript_snippet: We were able to identify one of those individuals in the photo and he is Austrian.

claims.label: Host Says Lyman Suggested the Gothic Girls Might Have Been Suspicious or Aware of the Shooting
claims.claim: The host says that the previous day her show poked fun at the narrative Phil Lyman seemed to be trying to spin, suggesting that the so-called gothic girls could have been suspicious, or at least aware that the shooting was going to occur.
claims.investigative_direction: Review the Alex Jones segment to determine whether Lyman himself drew that implication.
claims.transcript_snippet: suggesting that {quote} {unquote} gothic girls might have been suspicious that they maybe could have been responsible or aware at least that the shooting was going to occur.

claims.label: Host Says Phil Lyman Sent Her Footage Recorded After Multiple Shots
claims.claim: The host says that Phil Lyman sent her footage of himself after the shots rang out, and that she says shots in the plural deliberately.
claims.investigative_direction: Run audio analysis on the original file to count discrete shots and compare with the shot count in other recordings.
claims.transcript_snippet: gratefully, Phil Lyman did send us footage of him after the shots rang out and I am saying shots plural for a reason because we will show you that video.

claims.label: Host Says Lyman Told Alex Jones He Heard of Video of a Man Leaving the Roof and Escaping by Another Route
claims.claim: The host plays Phil Lyman telling Alex Jones that someone had reported video of a man coming off the roof, walking to the parking lot and driving away in a car with another individual, that this is not the story that came out, that he escaped another route, and that people are coordinating this.
claims.investigative_direction: Obtain the full Alex Jones interview and ask Lyman who told him about the video and which route he meant.
claims.transcript_snippet: Well, that's not the story that came was that he that he escaped another route. And there's there are people who are coordinating this thing.

claims.label: Host Plays Lyman Saying He Does Not Believe the .30-06 Was Ever on the Roof
claims.claim: The host plays Phil Lyman telling Alex Jones that he does not believe the .30-06 rifle shown recovered in the bushes was ever on the roof, while saying he is not claiming Tyler Robinson was not the shooter.
claims.investigative_direction: Compare Lyman's statement with the official account of where the rifle was recovered and with the evidence logs.
claims.transcript_snippet: I do not believe that that.30-06 that they showed recovered in the bushes was ever on the roof.
